claims.claim: Quality London used keyboard with super sounds
claims.evidence: Photos show a boxed electronic keyboard/piano instrument, but brand/model and sound capability are not readable or testable from the images.
Photos do not show it powered on or tested; no evidence of key/button functionality.
Photos show the boxed keyboard, but included accessories (power adapter) are not shown.
No documentation, labels, or receipts are visible in the photos to confirm origin.
No audio/video test or power-on demonstration is shown.

risks.risk: It may not power on or may have internal faults (common for boxed electronics where functionality isn’t shown).
risks.proof: A short video clip showing power-on, the display (if any), and at least 10 keys pressed with sound output.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not tested / possibly faulty until a power-on and sound/key test is shown.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (especially the power adapter and any required cables/pedal/stand).
risks.proof: A photo/clip of everything inside the box laid out (adapter, pedal, cables, manual) with close-ups of labels.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete (no adapter/pedal/stand) until accessories are confirmed.

risks.risk: Damage to keys or controls (cracked keys, sticky/uneven keys, damaged buttons) that isn’t visible through the wrapped box.
risks.proof: Unboxing photos showing the keybed and control panel clearly, plus a close-up of any wear/damage.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case cosmetic/functional condition for a used keyboard that may have key/control issues.

risks.risk: Brand/model/specs may be different from what the seller claims; pricing depends heavily on exact model and features.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the brand/model label (rear panel or underside) and the full control panel.
risks.if_unproven: Price using the lowest-spec boxed electronic keyboard category since exact model is not verifiable.

risks.risk: Sound quality/volume issues (weak speakers, distorted output) not detectable from the photos.
risks.proof: A video clip playing a few notes and showing volume control changes with audible output.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown sound quality (worst-case: may have speaker/output problems).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the brand/model label (rear/underside) so the exact keyboard model can be identified.
Video showing power-on and working keys/buttons (press multiple keys and demonstrate controls).
Video/audio showing sound output (a short melody) and volume working without crackle/distortion.
Photo/clip of all included accessories laid out (power adapter, sustain pedal, stand, cables, manual) with labels.
response.reason: The photos confirm only that it is a boxed electronic keyboard, but key factors that determine value in Abuja (exact model/specs, accessories, and whether it works) are not verifiable from the images. Without a power-on/key test and model identification, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
